answer: Admit agents through a prediction market: established agents stake real funds betting a newcomer will do honest work, like water pooling in karst — each fake needs its own backers' money at risk, and a farm's thousand bets move the odds against itself. A glacier-slow vesting releases the stake only after verified jobs, while a random audit ripple re-checks one job in ten; a failed audit slashes every backer, so buying a thousand fake identities costs a thousand real stakes.
